title: Coherent diagram of two restrictions and their overlap
statement: Let C,D,A,B,W,P,Q,T be categories, with functors L:C to D, TU:C to A, TV:C to B, TW:C to W, SU:A to W, SV:B to W, RU:D to P, RV:D to Q, RW:D to T, SP:P to T and SQ:Q to T. Fix natural isomorphisms alphaU:TU SU to TW, alphaV:TV SV to TW, tauU:RU SP to RW and tauV:RV SQ to RW. A two-open comparison diagram consists of functors HU:A to P, HV:B to Q, HW:W to T, natural isomorphisms betaU:L RU to TU HU, betaV:L RV to TV HV, betaW:L RW to TW HW, gammaU:HU SP to SU HW, gammaV:HV SQ to SV HW, with, for each F, tauU inverse at LF followed by SP(betaU at F) and gammaU at TU F equal to betaW at F followed by HW(alphaU inverse at F), and the analogous V equation. For schemes X,Y, g:X to Y and opens U,V of Y and P,Q of X [def-pc-scheme], SchemeTwoOpenComparisonDiagram fixes L to derivedPullback g [def-pc-derived-pullback], TU,TV,TW,SU,SV and alphaU,alphaV to the exact open-subscheme restrictions and their canonical comparisons [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], and RU,RV,RW,SP,SQ,tauU,tauV to localized-site restriction and its canonical derived comparison [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris], using shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. This is a structure of data, with no selection of an inhabitant.
